```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}

prj_root = "<PROJECT_ROOT>/"



# kaks of pangenome
dnds_dir = "<PROJECT_ROOT>/Results/DNDS/"
dnds_df = read_csv(paste0(dnds_dir, "RSSC_kaks2_df.csv"))

# twilight pangenome
twilight_classification <-
  read_tsv("<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/Figure_2/Data/twilight_classification_updated.tab")

# twilight_classification <- read_tsv(paste0(prj_root, "Results/", "TWILIGHT_ANALYSIS_IQTREE_FASTBAPS/", "classification.tab"))

# gene ontology annotatio from eggNog mapper
eggnog_result <- read_tsv(paste0(prj_root, "Results/Pangenome/PANAROO/RSSC-sensitive/PANGENOME_EGGNOG/RSSCsensitivePANAROO.emapper.annotations"),
                          comment = "##")

nglb_results <- read_tsv(paste0(prj_root, 'Results/Annotation/results/09_GO_annotation_table/pan_genome_reference/pan_genome_reference.GOannotation.tsv'), 
                         col_names = F)



gene2go <- nglb_results %>% 
  separate_rows(., X2, sep = ",")

colnames(gene2go) <- c("query", "GOs")

```


Proportion by selection pressure(purifying vs positive)
```{r}
dnds_df %>% 
  mutate(status = ifelse(kaks > 1, 'positive', 'purifying')) %>% 
  group_by(status) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()/nrow(.)  * 100)

```

```{r}

```


Proportion in Pangenome
```{r}

dnds_df %>% 
  mutate(gene = str_replace_all(gene, "___", "~~~")) %>%    
  left_join(twilight_classification, by = c("gene"  = "gene_name"))   %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene, kaks, general_class) %>% 
  mutate(class = ifelse(grepl("Core", general_class), 'Core', 'Accessory')) %>% 
  mutate(selection = ifelse(kaks > 1, 'positive', 'purifying')) %>% 
  group_by(selection, class) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(class) %>% 
  mutate(total = sum(n),
         prop = n/total * 100) %>% 
  arrange(class, selection,prop)
  
  

```

```{r}

dnds_df %>%
  mutate(gene = str_replace_all(gene, "___", "~~~")) %>% 
  left_join(twilight_classification, by = c("gene" = "gene_name")) %>%      
  dplyr::select(gene, kaks, specific_class) %>% 
  mutate(selection = ifelse(kaks > 1, 'positive', 'purifying')) %>% 
  group_by(selection, specific_class) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(specific_class) %>% 
  mutate(total = sum(n),
         prop = n/total * 100) %>%   
  # filter(grepl("core", specific_class)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = specific_class, names_from = selection, values_from = prop)
  
```


```{r}
library(GO.db)

# term2go <- as.character(gene2go$X2)

go_names <-  AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db,
                                   keys = as.character(gene2go$GOs),
                                   columns = c("TERM"),
                                   keytype = "GOID")



# go_names <- AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db,
#                                  keys = as.character(gene2go$GO_ID),  # Use correct column
#                                  columns = "TERM",
#                                  keytype = "GOID")   
# 

go_names_with_ontology <-  AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, 
                                                 keys = gene2go$GOs, 
                                                 columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(TERM, ONTOLOGY)



# AnnotationDbi::columns(GO.db)



term2name <- go_names[, c("GOID", "TERM")]
colnames(term2name) <- c("term", "name")



```



## Computet the ORA from core, accessory and others
```{r}

library(clusterProfiler)


core_enrichment <- twilight_classification %>% 
  filter(general_class == "Core") %>%
  pull(gene_name) %>%
  clusterProfiler::enricher(
    universe = twilight_classification$gene_name,
    TERM2GENE = gene2go %>% dplyr::select("GOs", "query"),
    TERM2NAME = term2name
  )



top50_core <-
core_enrichment@result %>%
filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
remove_rownames() %>%
dplyr::select(ID, Description, geneID, p.adjust)  %>%
  # left_join(go_names_with_ontology, by = c("ID" = "GOID"))
# separate_longer_delim(geneID, delim = "/") %>%

# left_join(dnds_df, by = c("geneID" = "gene")) %>%

# pull(ONTOLOGY) %>%
# unique()

filter(Description != "NA") %>%
dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>% 
# distinct(Description)
dplyr::top_n(50)

core_enriched_dnds <- core_enrichment@result %>% 
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% 
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, Description, geneID, p.adjust) %>% 
  # separate_longer_delim(geneID, delim = "/") %>% 
  # left_join(dnds_df, by = c("geneID" = "gene")) %>% 
  left_join(go_names_with_ontology, 
            by = c("Description" = "TERM")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(Description != "NA") %>% 
  
  group_by(ONTOLOGY) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(geneID, delim = "/") %>% 
  left_join(dnds_df, by = c("geneID" = "gene")) %>% 
  filter(kaks != "NA") %>% 
  group_by(Description) %>% 
  # filter(kaks < 0.35) %>%
  mutate(median_kaks = median(kaks)) %>% 
 
  filter(!grepl("^GO:", Description)) %>%
# group_by(Description) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = kaks, y = reorder(Description, median_kaks), fill = ONTOLOGY)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = ONTOLOGY), size = 0.8) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, width = 1.4, linewidth = 0.9) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.5, outliers = F) +
  

  theme_bw(base_size = 26) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  # facet_wrap(~ ONTOLOGY, scales = "free") +
  ggsci::scale_fill_d3() +
  ggsci::scale_color_d3() + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.5)) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("ka/ks")
  



# core_enrichment %>%
  # enrichplot::dotplot()




core_enriched_dnds

```

Coinfinder co-incident 
```{r}

pairs <- read_tsv("<PROJECT_ROOT>/Results/Coincident_Coinfinder/Coincident_Coinfinder_pairs.tsv")


# pairs %>% View()


pair1 <- pairs$Source
pair2 <- pairs$Target

coincident_genes <- c(pair1, pair2)


# number of unique gene families that are participating in network
coincident_genes %>% 
  unique() %>%
  length()


coincident_enrichment <-  coincident_genes %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  clusterProfiler::enricher(.,
    universe = unique(twilight_classification$gene_name),
    TERM2GENE = gene2go %>% dplyr::select("GOs", "query"),
    TERM2NAME = term2name
  )


coincident_enrichment %>% 
  enrichplot::dotplot()
  

coincident_kaks <- coincident_enrichment@result %>% 
  
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, Description, geneID, p.adjust) %>%
  # separate_longer_delim(geneID, delim = "/") %>% 
  # left_join(dnds_df, by = c("geneID" = "gene")) %>% 
  left_join(go_names_with_ontology, 
            by = c("Description" = "TERM")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(Description != "NA") %>% 
  
  group_by(ONTOLOGY) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(geneID, delim = "/") %>% 
  left_join(dnds_df, by = c("geneID" = "gene")) %>% 
  filter(kaks != "NA") %>% 
  group_by(Description) %>% 
  # filter(kaks > 1) %>% 
  mutate(median_kaks = median(kaks)) %>% 
  # View()
  
  ggplot(., aes(x = kaks, y = reorder(Description, -median_kaks), fill = ONTOLOGY)) +
  # geom_boxplot() +
  # theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
   geom_jitter(aes(color = ONTOLOGY), size = 0.8) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5,  linewidth = 0.9) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.5, outliers = F) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 26) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  # facet_wrap(~ ONTOLOGY, scales = "free") +
  ggsci::scale_fill_d3() +
   ggsci::scale_color_d3() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2.5)) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("ka/ks")






coincident_kaks %>% 
  ggsave(., filename = "<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/coincident_enrichment_kaks.png",
         width = 14, height = 7)

# coincident_enrichment %>%
  # enrichplot::dotplot()
```


```{r}
ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = list(core_enriched_dnds, rare_enrichment_dnds,

                  nrow = 2, ncol = 2,
                  align = "hv",
                  common.legend = T,
                  labels = c("(A)", "(B)", "(C)", "(D)")
                  ) %>% 
  
  ggsave(., filename = "<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/GO_kaks_plot_final.pdf",
         device = "pdf", width = 30, height = 25, dpi = 350)
```
